concept: Recognizing when a boundary needs to be firm and non-negotiable, versus flexible
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.scenario: Student compares two situations — one where a firm, non-negotiable boundary is warranted, one where flexibility is reasonable
exercise.branching_choice: Student sorts and explains which is which
exercise.practice: Socratic follow-up on what makes the difference between the two cases

assessment.success_marker: student articulates a real distinguishing principle (e.g. safety/dignity vs. preference), not just a gut feeling
